headline: Police chief reports low staffing, steady arrests, and a small group driving many downtown incidents.
summary: The police chief presented the monthly data report through September. Staffing stands at 54 sworn officers, with vacancies in other roles as well. Commissioners also discussed edits to the annual report.
discussion: Staffing and recruitment: Members asked whether low applications and reluctance to move to Burlington were behind the shortage. The chief said recruitment is a challenge in many cities.
Impact cohort: About 72 people account for roughly 20% of incidents. Two-thirds are unhoused, and trespass counts for this group have risen.
Low-barrier shelter: Members said a 100-bed shelter may not meet the need. The chief said some low-barrier shelter is needed before winter.
Ticketing and accountability: Ticket counts fell after the City Circle program ended. The chief said officers see little benefit in ordinance tickets without follow-through.
Annual report edits: Members discussed adding the resolution and website work. They also agreed to check the data appendices with the data analyst and add a signature section.
